name: Declutter Your Task List
equipment: Your current task list or to-do app
instructions: Go through your task list and remove or archive anything that has sat untouched for weeks -- it is not getting done, and it is only adding noise.
Sort what remains into "this week" and "someday," so your blocks are only built from things that genuinely matter now.
Set a 10-15 minute timer for this cleanup rather than letting it become its own overwhelming project.
Watch today's video for a gentler approach to decluttering an overwhelming list.
